items.title: A $5.4 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks

items.title: Cathie Wood and 73 Other Funds Bought Chip Stocks. Cerebras Is Down 59% Since. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCathie Wood’s ARK and dozens of other funds held Cerebras (CBRS:NASDAQ), Intel (INTC:NASDAQ), KLA (KLAC:NASDAQ), Applied Materials (AMAT:NASDAQ), or Lam Research (LRCX:NASDAQ) as of June 30, and all five stocks have fallen 53% to 59% since. Cerebras was a new holding for every fund that owned it.

items.title: Buy the dip or wait? BofA maps out 3 scenarios for chip stocks and top picks
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America sees a potential recovery in semiconductor stocks in early 2027 as improving U.S. policy clarity, corporate buybacks and relatively attractive valuations help ease concerns over artificial intelligence spending, although investors may need to wait for earnings estimate cuts before the sector finds a durable bottom.
